name: Eithne Treanor
title: Senior broadcast journalist and media interview coach

bio_long: Eithne is an international journalist and media interview coach. She has more than 20 years' experience as a television reporter for major international networks including BBC, Sky, Bloomberg and CNBC Europe. Her areas of expertise include energy, international business and politics. Eithne is an experienced interview coach and has advised many of the most senior executives and politicians on how to prepare and perform in reputation-sensitive interviews. She is an energising and authoritative media trainer, able to simulate a wide range of media situations. Her career across multiple major networks gives her an unusually broad perspective on how different media environments work. She understands the editorial priorities, interview techniques and production pressures at organisations ranging from public service broadcasters to specialist financial channels, and she uses this knowledge to prepare spokespeople for the specific media they will face. Eithne's specialism in energy and business journalism means she is particularly well-equipped to train executives in sectors where media scrutiny is intense and the stakes of a poor interview are high. She helps clients develop clear, compelling messages and the confidence to deliver them under pressure. Her simulated interview sessions are realistic and challenging, designed to push participants beyond their comfort zone in a supportive environment so they are ready for the real thing. She is known for her ability to combine direct, honest feedback with encouragement that builds confidence rather than undermining it.
